title: Coordinate an eligible routine release
description: Coordinate the existing release responsibilities for supported reviewed input around one exact prepared-candidate approval. The coordinator supplies bounded sequencing and result continuity, not a new general workflow policy or product decision.
inputs: Eligible reviewed release intent and established supported configuration.
Preparation, qualification, candidate, authorization, publication, public observation, and reporting results from their authoritative owners.
outputs: Prepared candidate for one normal maintainer approval and subsequent attributable operation results.
Precise intervention request or retained failure/uncertainty when supported progression cannot continue.
behavior: Derive supported profiles, notes, and projections from authoritative reviewed intent without duplicate manual entry.
Coordinate preparation and exact-candidate qualification before presenting its approval summary.
After applicable approval, continue covered publication, public observation, and durable reporting against the same retained subject.
Reuse existing authority and evidence semantics; an unchanged satisfactory recheck does not create redundant approval work.
Stop for ambiguous engineering/version choices, unsupported populations, missing setup, mismatched candidates, or uncertain writes and preserve each owner's actual disposition.

failure_behavior.condition: The operation needs a new product decision or lacks an established prerequisite.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return a precise owner intervention rather than inventing a value or expanding supported automation.

failure_behavior.condition: A stage fails, becomes stale, or reports an uncertain external effect.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop dependent progression and retain the responsible stage's correction/recovery meaning without manufacturing a successful handoff.
